smokeTestNotes: Product and pricing pages reviewed in October 2026.
name: RoomSketcher
shortDescription: Turns a 2D floor plan into a 3D floor plan. Pro is $144 a year.
longDescription: RoomSketcher creates a 2D plan or accepts an upload, then generates a 3D floor plan in one step. The free plan includes 2 starter credits and 1 AI floor plan conversion, and no card is required. Pro is billed as $144 per year, shown as $12 per month. Team is billed as $420 per year for 5 users.
pricingNotes: Free includes 2 credits and 1 AI floor plan conversion. Pro is billed as $144 per year. Team is billed as $420 per year for 5 users.
freeTierNotes: 1 free AI floor plan conversion and 2 starter credits. No card required.
bestFor: A 2D plan that should become a 3D floor plan
A realtor who wants a floor plan image for a listing
notIdealFor: A photoreal interior from a single room photo only
strength: RoomSketcher turns a 2D floor plan into a 3D floor plan, and the free plan includes one AI conversion.
weakness: Pro is billed as $144 per year, and many 3D outputs spend the monthly credits.
